dedupe_keys.name: short term electricity load forecasting panama

description: This forecasting benchmark combines hourly electricity load in Panama from January 2015 through June 2020 with historical weekly operator forecasts, weather for three main cities, holidays and school-calendar information. Ernesto Aguilar Madrid identifies ETESA Centro Nacional de Despacho post-dispatch and pre-dispatch reports, Earthdata and calendar sources as inputs. The target is a 168-hour weekly forecast. The provider defines Saturday-start weeks, a 72-hour unseen-data gap and chronological training/testing. Two CSV files contain merged variables and operator forecasts; two Excel files provide suggested regressors and fourteen training/test pairs, including lockdown weeks. The linked Mendeley version1 is explicitly the less-processed form of this collection and is grouped here. It is distinct from the existing general CND statistics portal. Access is through native repository descriptions and listed files; payload access and cost were not tested. The Kaggle licence field says Other but supplies no explicit terms in its description, so reuse terms remain unknown. Neither the experimental PDF nor data files were obtained.
